description: Source code for the OpenMaxImageDecodeComponent class, which handles image decoding using OpenMax on Raspberry Pi. It includes methods for setting formats, decoding images, processing output, and managing port states.

classes.name: OpenMaxImageDecodeComponent
classes.description: A class that manages image decoding using OpenMax on Raspberry Pi, supporting format setting, decoding, and port management.

methods.name: GetCompressionFormat
methods.description: Returns the OMX image coding type corresponding to a given MIME type.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Performs image decoding on provided data, returning a decode target.

methods.name: SetInputFormat
methods.description: Configures the input port format based on MIME type.

methods.name: SetOutputFormat
methods.description: Sets the output image format and dimensions.

methods.name: ProcessOutput
methods.description: Processes the output buffer and updates decoding state.

methods.name: OnEnableOutputPort
methods.description: Handles actions when the output port is enabled, including setting up tunneling.
